templates.name: Sparkz Creator Launch
templates.description: Run a tokenless-first creator launch from spark intake and collectables through backing, boost momentum, collaborator approvals, and an optional graduation decision.

tasks.title: Capture the creator spark
tasks.description: Document the creator, release, audience, desired momentum, collaborators, and why the project matters without leading with a token.

tasks.title: Complete creator and project review
tasks.description: Confirm identity, quality bar, launch ownership, content rights, and the ZAO-backed acceptance decision.

tasks.title: Design the tokenless launch
tasks.description: Define collectables, backing mechanics, boost participation, community perks, and success signals before considering any token path.

tasks.title: Produce creator launch assets
tasks.description: Prepare the creator story, collectable media, campaign page, social assets, FAQs, and community update cadence.

tasks.title: Approve collaborator fee-split intent
tasks.description: Record participants, rationale, percentages, mutable split owner, and approval evidence without executing a transaction in Agora.

tasks.title: Review public language and claims
tasks.description: Use this workflow checklist to keep messaging feature-led and creator-friendly: backing and present-day perks, no promised returns, and no language that frames participation as a raise. This task is not legal advice.

tasks.title: Launch the spark
tasks.description: Publish the tokenless experience, activate collectables and backing, open boost participation, and begin the community update loop.

tasks.title: Review creator and community momentum
tasks.description: Assess collectable activity, backing, boost participation, creator engagement, operational risks, and qualitative community signals.

tasks.title: Decide whether the spark should graduate
tasks.description: Document a human-reviewed go, wait, or never-token decision. If approved, hand execution to the configured external rails; Agora remains the decision and evidence system.

milestones.title: Tokenless launch approved
milestones.description: Creator review, experience design, split intent, assets, and public language are approved.

milestones.title: Spark live
milestones.description: The tokenless creator experience is live and the community update loop has started.

milestones.title: Graduation decision recorded
milestones.description: The project has an evidence-backed go, wait, or never-token decision.

docs.title: Spark Brief
docs.body: Creator, project, audience, collaborators, current momentum, tokenless offer, success signals, and launch owner.

docs.title: Legal-Safe Messaging Checklist
docs.body: Lead with features. Say backing and present-day perks. Avoid raise, promised returns, guaranteed upside, or coin-first framing. Record reviewer and approval date.

docs.title: Collaborator Split Decision
docs.body: Participants, contribution rationale, proposed percentages, mutable split owner, approvals, external contract reference, and revision history. Agora records intent and evidence; external rails execute.

docs.title: Graduation Decision Record
docs.body: Momentum evidence, creator preference, risks, legal review, fee and governance proposal, go/wait/never outcome, approvers, and external execution handoff.

intakeForm.title: Creator Spark Intake
intakeForm.description: Capture the creator, project, collaborators, audience, tokenless launch idea, rights posture, and desired community outcome.
